subtitles.en: I'm going to wait to ask you all the questions you don't want to answer for a little bit, but I have to ask one thing first Is there going to be some news that I have to be following while we're sitting here or has something happen while I was a thing?
subtitles.zh: 我待会儿再问那些你不想回答的问题，但先得问一件事：我们坐这儿的时候，会不会有什么新闻我得盯着？还是我来之前已经出什么事了？

subtitles.en: I make one one quick point. Yeah, most people we made this plan months ago, right most people in my position given what's going on
subtitles.zh: 我简单说一点。我们几个月前就定好了这个计划，换作大多数人处在我这个位置，看到现在的情况，

subtitles.en: Probably would have canceled on you. Oh, you're here failing for sympathy. No, I would never leave you high and dry and
subtitles.zh: 可能早就放你鸽子了。哦，你是来博同情的。不，我绝不会让你干等，而且

subtitles.en: I wanted to see you so that said you're probably going to ask me questions that will annoy you. My answers will annoy you, but go ahead No, I'm going to start with some softies. Okay, so you joined HBO in 2004
subtitles.zh: 我想见你，所以说，你大概会问些让你自己恼火的问题，我的回答也会让你恼火，但问吧。不，我先问几个温和的。好，你2004年加入HBO，

subtitles.en: One of your favorite topics is At the time your competition was showtime and stars and Effects and AMC came around well, no, when I started was really showtime HBO and showtime. Yeah, but I was over the next five years
subtitles.zh: 你最爱聊的话题之一。当时你的竞争对手是Showtime、Starz，后来AMC也起来了。不，我刚入行时主要是Showtime和HBO。对，但接下来五年，

subtitles.en: You had AMC with madmen and and that's it anyways Why do you think that every single one of those other companies or brands either doesn't exist or is kind of in a diminished form
subtitles.zh: AMC有《广告狂人》等等。总之，为什么其他那些公司或品牌要么消失了，要么大不如前，

subtitles.en: Whereas HBO is still a name that everyone knows Well, I mean some of it is going to be corporate ownership and who prioritized what so
subtitles.zh: 而HBO依然是家喻户晓的名字？部分原因是公司所有权，以及谁优先重视什么，

subtitles.en: But they prioritize HBO for a reason. Yes, they did and what I would say is I was lucky enough to grow up and most of my team has been at HBO for at least 20 years
subtitles.zh: 但他们优先重视HBO是有原因的。是的。我想说的是，我很幸运能成长起来，我团队里大多数人都在HBO待了至少20年。

winning_patterns: 机构/人物权威 + 具体数字/资产 + 强问题，例如 高盛王逸：4-5万亿城市更新会拖住楼市吗
大机构/名人 + 被逼/陷阱/真相/转向 等张力词，例如 野村辜朝明：日本央行被逼到墙角
具体数据 + 政策动作疑问，例如 6月PMI释放积极信号，政府会加码吗
反常识判断 + 下一步条件，例如 低估值可能是价值陷阱，需等待政策转向消费
中国相关议题更容易获得点击，但表达要落在政策、需求、信心、估值、产业升级这些正向框架

让观众产生单一强反应：居然如此、终于有人说、他说的是真的吗、原来中国优势在这里
大实话角度来自表达者身份与观点反差；言行反差角度必须有公开动作或披露支撑

avoid_patterns: 过长的新闻句，尤其是 24 字以上还塞多个从句
